title: Bricks Falling When Hit
description: Determine how many bricks fall when a hit removes a brick at a given position in a grid.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize DSU with grid size
2. Union all bricks that are stable (connected to ceiling)
3. Iterate hits in reverse
4. For each hit, check if it reconnects to stable component
5. Count newly added bricks to the stable component

steps.note: Initialize DSU with grid size for a 2x2 grid
Union stable bricks (top row) with each other
Process hit at (1, 1) in reverse; temporarily place brick back
Check neighbors of (1, 1) to see if they are part of a stable component
Count bricks attached to stable component, result is 1
